Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: A cathode homogenization strategy for enabling long-cycle-life all-solid-state lithium batteries

Raw_Evidence_Span: Li1.75Ti2(Ge0.25P0.75S3.8Se0.2)3 (referred to as LTG0.25PSSe0.2; Supplementary Table 3)

Process_Text.original: Stoichiometric reagents of Li2S (Alfa Aesar, 99.9%), P2S5 (MACKLIN, >= 99%), TiS2 (MERDA, 99.95%), GeS2 (Aladdin, 99.999%) and TiSe2 (Alfa Aesar, 99.9%) are placed in a sealed zirconia pot. The mixtures are ball milled for 40 h at a speed of 370 rpm. The obtained powders are then pelletized in a 12 mm diameter mould and sealed in a quartz tube together with slight excess of sulfur (MACKLIN, 99.99%). After annealing at 400 C for 8 h, the pellets are removed from the tube and grinded manually in a mortar to obtain the target powders. All procedures are conducted under argon.
Process_Text.simplified: Ball milling (40 h, 370 rpm, sealed zirconia pot, Ar) -> pelletization (12 mm die) -> sealed quartz tube annealing (400 C, 8 h, excess S) -> manual grinding

Stage3_Annealing.Atmosphere: sealed quartz tube with slight excess of sulfur

Structure_Text.original: The XRD patterns of Se-tuned LTG0.25PS with Se content <= 0.2 fit well with that of LTG0.25PS. The element homogeneity is revealed by the elemental mapping analysis. A new Raman peak at 370 cm-1 represents PS3Se3+ tetrahedron. LTG0.25PSSe0.2 undergoes a volume change of 1.2% with six Li+ inserted.
Structure_Text.simplified: Hexagonal structure (P6cc) confirmed by XRD Rietveld refinement. No impurity at Se <= 0.2. Edge-sharing TiS6 octahedra + (P/Ge)(S/Se)4 tetrahedra forming open 3D framework. Volume change 1.2% with 6 Li+ insertion.

Raw_Evidence_Span: Li6PS5Cl is synthesized by the solid-state reaction
the ASLB with the LTG0.25PSSe0.2|Li6PS5Cl|Li-Si configuration

Process_Text.original: Li6PS5Cl is synthesized by the solid-state reaction with stoichiometric reagents of Li2S (Alfa Aesar, 99.9%), LiCl (MACKLIN, >=99%) and P2S5 (MACKLIN, >=99%). The starting materials are thoroughly mixed in a hermetically sealed zirconia container and subjected to ball milling for 24 h at 600 rpm. The resulting mixture is then compressed into pellets, placed within a quartz tube, annealed at 550 C for 5 h, followed by gradual cooling to room temperature. The pellets are pulverized using an agate mortar. All procedures under argon.
Process_Text.simplified: Ball milling (24 h, 600 rpm, sealed zirconia, Ar) -> pelletization -> sealed quartz tube annealing (550 C, 5 h) -> gradual cooling to RT -> pulverize in agate mortar

Raw_Evidence_Span: The Li-Si alloy anode is prepared using Li-Si alloy powders and Li3N powders

Process_Text.original: Li-Si alloy (Li3.5Si) powders are prepared by manual grinding the stoichiometric mixtures of Si powders and the scrap lithium foil in a glovebox filled with Ar atmosphere. Several drops of 0.1 mol L-1 lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in tetrahydrofuran solution is used as the lubricant. Dark grey Li3.5Si powders are obtained after tetrahydrofuran is evaporated. The Li-Si alloy anode are finally obtained by manual grinding the as-prepared Li-Si alloy powders and Li3N powders according to a weight ratio of 10:1.
Process_Text.simplified: Si + Li foil manual grinding in Ar glovebox (with LiFSI/THF lubricant) -> THF evaporation -> Li3.5Si + Li3N manual grinding (10:1 wt ratio)

Raw_Evidence_Span: the ASLB with the LTG0.25PSSe0.2|Li6PS5Cl|Li-Si configuration
a very long cycle life of over 20,000 cycles without failure at 2.5 mA cm-2

Process_Text.original: 80 mg Li6PS5Cl powders are first pressed at 200 MPa as the electrolyte layer. Then the prepared sample powders are added homogeneously on the top of the electrolyte layer and compressed at 350 MPa. In the end, Li-Si alloy anode powders are added on the bottom of the Li6PS5Cl layer and compressed for 2 min at 350 MPa. The stack pressure is 50 MPa during battery operation.
Process_Text.simplified: Li6PS5Cl 80 mg pressed at 200 MPa -> cathode powder added, pressed at 350 MPa -> Li-Si anode pressed at 350 MPa for 2 min -> stack pressure 50 MPa during operation

Structure_Text.original: The ASLB with the LTG0.25PSSe0.2|Li6PS5Cl|Li-Si configuration has an integrated three-tier dense structure, which can be unambiguously distinguished by the consistent dispersion of Ti, Ge, P, S and Se in the respective layers.
Structure_Text.simplified: Three-tier dense structure: LTG0.25PSSe0.2 cathode | Li6PS5Cl electrolyte | Li-Si anode with clear elemental layer separation
